title: 2026-11-27 · Open PR review and merge plan

sections.name: summary
sections.content: Owner and Claude Code reviewed all 21 open PRs across the SRS repositories and set a merge order. The conversation turned to srs#1035 (RFC-051 Revision 16, which run is kept when several ordered runs tie in a whole-outline replace), where the owner stated a principle about preferring the expected behaviour over an incumbent counter-intuitive one.
